cd /tmp/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, json, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import t6
from harness import run
from common import validate
rng = random.Random(6*977+13)
job = t6.random_campaign(rng)
out, err = run(job)
print('active', out['active_requests'])
print('plan', json.dumps(out['plan']))
print('brute', t6.brute(job,out))
print('feasible', t6.feasible(job,out))
for o in job['offers']:
    print('offer', o['id'], o['time'], o['service'], o['prefix'], o['capacity'], o['cost'], o['group'], o['requests'])
for r in job['requests']:
    print('req', r)
print('oq', job['offer_quotas'])
print('rq', job['request_quotas'])
print('snap states', [(l['lease'], l['state'], l['internal']) for l in out['snapshots'][0]['leases']])
EOF
